s.note: Crystal-clear beef consommé with herb dumplings.
s.how: Whisk the mince, egg whites, carrot, celery, leek and tomato into the cold stock in a deep pot. Bring slowly to a bare simmer without stirring; a raft forms on top. Simmer gently, untouched. Ladle the clear stock out through a muslin-lined sieve and season. Beat the semolina, egg, butter and chives, shape small dumplings with two teaspoons and poach them in the consommé until they swell.

s.n: Crossed Keys smoked trout on rye
s.note: Smoked trout with horseradish cream on dark rye.
s.how: Toss the cucumber with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt and leave 10 minutes. Stir the horseradish into the crème fraîche. Spread the rye with the cream, top with trout and drained cucumber. Finish with dill and cut into neat fingers.

m.note: Paprika-braised beef cheeks with buttered spätzle, cheap cuts done right.
m.how: Dust the cheeks in flour, season and brown well in the oil, then lift out. Soften the onions and garlic, stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste, then add the stock, capsicum and cheeks. Cover and braise at 160C until the cheeks give to a spoon. Beat 250g flour, the eggs, milk and salt to a thick batter, push it through a colander into boiling water, then drain and toss in the butter. Serve the cheeks on the spätzle with a spoon of sour cream.
shop: 2 tbsp plain flour, plus 250g for the spätzle@Pantry

m.n: Schloss Lutz roast duck with red cabbage
m.note: Roast duck breast with braised red cabbage and apple.
m.how: Soften the onion in the butter, add the cabbage, apple, vinegar, sugar, juniper and cinnamon with a splash of water, cover and braise until soft and glossy. Score the duck skin, season and start skin-side down in a cold pan over medium heat until the fat renders and the skin is crisp. Flip, roast at 200C for 6 minutes, then rest. Warm the redcurrant jelly with the pan juices, slice the duck and serve on the cabbage.

w.note: Choux buns stacked with vanilla custard and mocha glaze, baked with tools inside.
w.how: Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour until it leaves the sides, cool a little and beat in the eggs one by one. Pipe 4 large, 4 medium and 4 small rounds and bake at 200C until puffed and dry. Poke a hole in each and fill with the custard. Mix the icing sugar with the cocoa and coffee for a mocha glaze and dip the tops. Stack large, medium and small, pipe a little pink icing trim and top with a cocoa bean.
shop: 1 tbsp pink food colouring and a little icing sugar for the trim@Pantry
4 cocoa beans or chocolate buttons for the top@Pantry

d.n: Checkpoint Nineteen bison grass and apple
d.note: Zubrowka bison grass vodka with cloudy apple juice.
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Pour in the vodka and top with apple juice. Add an apple slice and the faintest dust of cinnamon.

shopping: 2 tbsp plain flour, plus 250g for the spätzle@Pantry
